title: Mass. man dies after rock climbing fall on Appalachian Trail in Conn.
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Local News Collin Salmon, 30, of Great Barrington, Massachusetts, died at a Connecticut hospital.
A Massachusetts man died after falling while rock climbing in Connecticut, officials said.

On Thursday afternoon, Environmental Conservation Police and Connecticut State Police responded to a report of a fall victim on the Appalachian Trail on River Road in Kent, the Connecticut Department of Energy and Environmental Protection said.
